purpose: Selection record for oct-output FP32 remainder-row sharing versus the merged quad-output kernel

baseline.description: Merged quad-output (four-column) FP32 remainder-row kernel from PR #59

candidate.description: Remainder-row loop shares each input load across eight output accumulators; four-, two- and one-column loops handle column tails. Per-output ascending-index accumulation order unchanged.

kernel_results.median_ratio_summary: Oct vs quad baseline across three fresh processes: workers1 decode shapes ~0.61-0.75, workers4 ~0.74-0.88; five-row mixed ~0.95-0.99. Identical outputs at every step.

generation_results.median_ratio_summary: Synthetic FP32 fixture, 64 paired trials per process, three processes: prefix33/outputs128 ~0.83, prefix33/outputs8 ~0.92, prefix3/outputs1 ~0.78-0.80, long-prefill one-token ~0.997. Every completion matched.

real_model.model: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, f32 weights, greedy, threads=4, 128 tokens

limitations: Synthetic FP32 fixture and a single real model on one Apple M4 host
No claim for quantized kernels, other platforms/toolchains, prefill-heavy loads, tail latency or memory footprint
